reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: AI-driven national economic transformation
themes.definition: Speaker describes the country's own plans to digitize and make its economy AI-driven, and current national deployment of AI systems in services and environmental monitoring.
themes.inclusion: Include descriptions of national AI deployment, AI-driven economic visions, or domestic AI investments.
themes.exclusion: Exclude calls for global AI rules without domestic content.
themes.boundary_cases: Domestic AI use in health, education and environment may also be coded AI_DEVELOPMENT_SDGS.

examples.quote: transforming its economy into one that is fully digitized and driven by artificial intelligence (AI)
We are using and expanding artificial intelligence systems to deliver essential services such as healthcare, education and social welfare.

themes.label: Digital literacy for an AI generation
themes.definition: Investing in digital literacy from a young age so a generation can use AI to deliver services and compete in the digital economy.
themes.inclusion: Include passages on building AI-related skills or literacy among young people.
themes.exclusion: Exclude general education reforms without AI linkage.
themes.boundary_cases: Domestic regulatory and start-up measures in the same passage belong to AI_NATIONAL_STRATEGY.

examples.quote: invest in people’s digital literacy from a young age to build a generation that can use artificial intelligence

themes.label: AI overcoming distance and scale for small states
themes.definition: AI is framed as especially valuable for small and island states by closing distance and overcoming scale in service delivery.
themes.inclusion: Include passages linking AI benefits to small-state or island geographic constraints.
themes.exclusion: Exclude general AI development benefits not tied to smallness or dispersion.
themes.boundary_cases: Generic health/education benefits without the small-state framing go to AI_DEVELOPMENT_SDGS.

examples.quote: For small states, AI can close distance. It can help overcome scale.

themes.label: Every country's voice in AI rules
themes.definition: Call that all countries have a voice in shaping global AI rules and that the digital future not create dependence.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for inclusive participation in global AI rule-making.
themes.boundary_cases: Warnings about dependence also fit AI_SOVEREIGNTY_CONCENTRATION.

examples.quote: Every country must have a voice in shaping the global rules for AI.

themes.label: Avoiding new forms of technological dependence
themes.definition: Concern that the AI/digital transformation should not create new dependence for small states.
themes.inclusion: Include warnings about dependence on external technology or partners in the AI context.
themes.boundary_cases: Paired with calls for a voice in rules, also code AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE.

examples.quote: The digital future should strengthen our ability to serve our people better, not create new forms of dependence.

value.rationale: Maldives 2024 passages describe a domestic AI-driven economic vision, deployment and skills; 2026 shifts to a small-state framing of AI benefits plus demands for a voice in global rules and avoidance of dependence.
